name: EK Cha
notes: EK Cha b protoplanet candidate: ALMA 1.3 mm continuum source 0.35 arcsec SW of the star, CO J=2-1 counterpart, HST/ACS photometry (Alarcon et al. 2026); ~8.8 Myr

images.wavelength_label: 1.3 mm continuum; unresolved disk + EK Cha b CPD candidate 0.46" SW (5.1 sigma)
images.credit: Alarcon et al. 2026, Fig. 1 (top panel, crop)

paper.title: EK Cha b: multi-tracer detection of a protoplanet candidate in a gas-rich environment

images.note: ALMA Band 6 continuum (277 +/- 54 uJy, rms 32.6 uJy/beam) of EK Cha: the stellar disk is unresolved at the centre and a detached unresolved source, EK Cha b, is detected 461 +/- 42 mas (46 au) to the SW at PA 200 deg, significance 5.1 sigma. Both sources are labelled in the panel; the synthesised beam is shown at bottom left. The SW source is the candidate circumplanetary-disk detection (0.46 arcsec, 46 au); it is unresolved, so it is a point-like source, not resolved circumstellar structure.

images.wavelength_label: 12CO J=2-1 integrated intensity; candidate 0.46" SW at 5.3 sigma
images.credit: Alarcon et al. 2026, Fig. 1 (bottom panel, crop)

paper.title: EK Cha b: multi-tracer detection of a protoplanet candidate in a gas-rich environment

images.note: Velocity-integrated CO J=2-1 map with 1.3 mm continuum contours. The gas disk is extended, and compact CO emission is recovered at EK Cha b's position (5.3 sigma) inside the white box; the inset shows the CO velocity centroid there, with a gradient consistent with a Keplerian circumplanetary disk. Same Band 6 dataset as the continuum record.

images.wavelength_label: F814W 0.814 um; EK Cha b detected 0.45" SW (star + candidate)
images.credit: Alarcon et al. 2026, Fig. 1 (middle panel, crop)

paper.title: EK Cha b: multi-tracer detection of a protoplanet candidate in a gas-rich environment

images.note: HST/ACS F814W (0.82 um) image of EK Cha with the 1.3 mm ALMA contours overlaid. The star dominates the centre (PSF FWHM ~84 mas) and EK Cha b is detected at 451 mas, PA 190 deg (2.94 +/- 0.01 x 1e-18 erg/s/cm2/A, about 300 sigma in a 3-pixel aperture) as a faint compact feature inside the SW contour (the star's PSF halo dominates the frame). Candidate separation in the two tracers agrees within 80 mas (1.7 sigma).

images.wavelength_label: F606W 0.606 um; star only, candidate undetected (3 sigma)

paper.title: EK Cha b: multi-tracer detection of a protoplanet candidate in a gas-rich environment

images.note: HST/ACS F606W image with ALMA 1.3 mm contours: only EK Cha's PSF is seen at the centre and there is no counterpart at the candidate position (3 sigma upper limit 1.05e-19 erg/s/cm2/A), giving F606W - F814W > 5.82. This is an imaged non-detection of the candidate, not a detection.

paper.title: EK Cha b: multi-tracer detection of a protoplanet candidate in a gas-rich environment

images.note: VLT/NACO H-band residual of EK Cha after high-contrast (ADI/PCA) PSF subtraction, same archival data discussed by Brandeker et al. (2006). No point source is present at EK Cha b's separation: 5 sigma upper limit 9.3e-17 erg/s/cm2/A. This is an imaged non-detection.

images.wavelength_label: Ks 2.2 um; high-contrast residual after PSF subtraction, no candidate

paper.title: EK Cha b: multi-tracer detection of a protoplanet candidate in a gas-rich environment

images.note: VLT/NACO Ks residual of EK Cha after annular-PCA ADI subtraction (3 PCA components; 56 min on source). No point source at EK Cha b's position; 5 sigma upper limit 1.34e-16 erg/s/cm2/A. Imaged non-detection.

images.wavelength_label: H-alpha 0.6563 um; KLIP residual, candidate undetected (1 sigma)
images.credit: Alarcon et al. 2026, Fig. A.4 (left panel, crop)

paper.title: EK Cha b: multi-tracer detection of a protoplanet candidate in a gas-rich environment

images.note: MUSE-NFM H-alpha line residual (S/N) after KLIP subtraction of the continuum; emission at EK Cha b's separation is recovered only at the ~1 sigma level, i.e. no detection. 5 sigma contrast Delta mag ~ 7.7 and 3 sigma line-flux upper limit 2.5e-9 Lsun at 461 mas. Imaged non-detection.

paper.title: EK Cha b: multi-tracer detection of a protoplanet candidate in a gas-rich environment

images.note: MUSE-NFM H-beta line residual after KLIP subtraction; no significant emission at EK Cha b's position (~1 sigma). 3 sigma line-flux upper limit 5.4e-9 Lsun. Separate panel/line from H-alpha, same epoch. Imaged non-detection.

planets.name: b
planets.note: Candidate protoplanet ~0.35-0.46 arcsec SW (~50-65 au) of EK Cha: 5.1 sigma ALMA 1.3 mm continuum point source, 5.3 sigma CO J=2-1 counterpart, and a 0.82 um HST/ACS detection; other bands give non-detections/upper limits (2026)
